title: Dune: Part Two
content:
Mixed feelings after a second viewing.

What works: the Arrakis sequences are the best-looking desert ever put on film, Zimmer's score is relentless in the right way, and Chalamet finally sells Paul's turn in the last act.

What doesn't: Chani's rewritten arc exists to set up the sequel rather than to serve this story, the Harkonnen arena sequence is gorgeous but inert, and the pacing in the middle hour drags because the film keeps restating its theme instead of advancing it.

Still worth seeing on the biggest screen you can find, but it's a 7, not the masterpiece the hype suggests.
